description: EPA Discharge of disinfected sewage from vessels carrying less than 16 people is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. The discharge of disinfected sewage from vessels carrying less than 16 people has been created in accordance with the Sewage Management Directive. The Discharge of Sewage from Certain Vessels into State Waters is a risk-based approach to sewage discharge which specifies where sewage may and may not be discharged from certain vessels into Tasmanian waters. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are MARINE-Coasts, MARINE-Estuaries, MARINE-Human-Impacts, POLLUTION-Water, WASTE-Sewage. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
